correctness.rationale: The submitted RESULT.md proof is sound for all distinct primes p,q and every n>0. If D²(n)=n, N=qν_p(n)+pν_q(n) and N' satisfy NN'=(pq)². Unique factorization gives the nine pairs N=p^u q^v, N'=p^(2-u)q^(2-v), 0≤u,v≤2. The valuation update enforces N'-N=(u-1)q+(v-1)p. Six sign/size contradictions, two cross-exponent contradictions and the forbidden N=1/N'=1 leave only (u,v)=(1,1), so D(n)=n. Solving qa+pb=pq gives p^p m or q^q m with gcd(m,pq)=1. Independent integer iteration checked 100000 (prime pair,n) cases; this is corroboration, not the universal proof. The finite test and actual verify.py were separately examined.
